rows.name:
You made her say she'd be better off not being around.
Doesn't that make you feel anything?

rows.label: bf07080100_0022
rows.name: She's planning to take them down with her!

rows.label: bf07080100_0040
rows.name:
After driving her to that
point, you still...

rows.label: bf07080100_0050
rows.name:
Did your wish to go to Eden with her
really mean so little?

rows.label: bf07080100_0060
rows.name: It's been a while. Dad[ML:Dash ] Mom[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf07080100_0070
rows.name: I became a Driver! Amazing, right?

rows.label: bf07080100_0100
rows.name: A very important person to me.

rows.label: bf07080100_0110
rows.name:
I've decided to go to Eden
together with Homura.

rows.label: bf07080100_0120
rows.name:
I don't know what will
happen from now on,

rows.label: bf07080100_0130
rows.name: but please watch over Homura and me.
